name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The next components are found in Desolace, far to the west of the Barrens and even the Stonetalon Mountains.

There, chaos still reigns after the Sundering. Both your strength and cunning will be tested there--you will face creatures of hatred and also of the Burning Legion.

From the Hatefury satyr in the northeast, bring me their blood. From the lesser infernals in Mannoroc Coven, bring me a lesser infernal stone.

We will use both in the construction of your robe.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent, adventurer. These will do nicely. I will prepare them now while you move on to your last two components. Are you ready?
narrative.requestItemsText:
Desolace is not a kind area: naga, giants, satyr, the Burning Legion... all of those and warring centaur clans all make the land dangerous if you're not careful.

Like I said before, it will not only test your strength and cunning, but also your patience. Be wary in those lands, adventurer.
